title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, documented behaviour, licensing qualifications and governance controls are supported. Both API calls are documented, including the allocation request body and the deprecated consumption endpoint; the automatic checks missed their parameterised examples.

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified at 2026-11-17T00:31:56.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Cost and licensing; Governance controls
claims.claim: Shared environment capacity controls affect other Copilot Studio workloads, including agents, workflows and prompts.
claims.quote: The capacity and consumption controls in the Power Platform admin center apply across Copilot Studio. They aren't exclusive to the Microsoft Copilot harness. Configure controls with the other Copilot Studio agents, workflows, and features in mind for each environment.

claims.claim: Tenant-pool draw is selected by default for eligible Copilot Studio environments without an allocation configuration.
claims.quote: For eligible Copilot Studio environments, Draw from the available capacity in my tenant is selected by default when no allocation configuration exists.

claims.claim: A published environment group rule makes the environment's tenant-draw setting read-only.
claims.quote: When you publish a rule, it governs every environment in the group. The environment-level setting becomes read-only in the Power Platform admin center

claims.claim: Programmatic requests cannot override the published environment group's tenant-draw rule.
claims.quote: Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the TenantPoolLockedByPolicy error.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and request body
claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 with the printed scope and MCSMessages allocation body sets the allocation and disables TenantPool draw.
claims.quote: scope = @{ environmentId = $environmentId }; allocatedEntitlements = @( @{ entitlementId = "MCSMessages"; allocation = @{ quantity = 5000 }; enforcementRules = @( @{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false } ) } )

claims.claim: The allocation request requires authenticated authorisation.
claims.quote: $headers = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $($auth.AccessToken)" }

claims.claim: The allocation call uses PUT, API version 2024-10-01 and Content-Type application/json.
claims.quote: $apiBaseUrl = "https://api.powerplatform.com"; $apiVersion = "2024-10-01"; Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion" -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json" -Body $allocationBody

claims.claim: Workflow consumption is reviewed in Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Copilot Studio, under Agent flow actions.
claims.quote: In the Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Copilot Studio, review the Agent flow actions used by each workflow.

claims.quote: GET https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/entitlements/{entitlementId}/environments/{environmentId}/resources?fromDate={fromDate}&toDate={toDate}&api-version=2024-10-01
